title: Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth
what_it_is: Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth

sections.label: MCCY national identity community focus
sections.summary: MCCY will focus on strengthening national identity and building a cohesive and caring community, stepping up engagement and developing arts, heritage and sports.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In this new term of Government, MCCY will focus on strengthening our national identity and building a cohesive and caring community.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To do this, we will step up our community and youth engagement efforts, whilst continuing to develop a vibrant arts, heritage and sports landscape.

sections.label: Deepening engagement via SGfuture
sections.summary: Engagement efforts will be deepened through various platforms including digital means, bringing Singaporeans together through SGfuture engagements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will deepen engagement efforts through various platforms, including digital means.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will bring Singaporeans together in charting our shared future, through the SGfuture engagements.

sections.label: National Youth Sports Institute setup
sections.summary: The new National Youth Sports Institute will identify sporting talent among youths and support their pursuit of sporting excellence in schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: For example, we are setting up the new National Youth Sports Institute as a platform to identify sporting talent amongst our youths and to support them in their pursuit of sporting excellence, both within the Singapore Sports School and in mainstream schools.

sections.label: Youth, volunteer and community programmes
sections.summary: NYC will reach out to more youths through Youth Corps Singapore, the Public Service will adopt more charities, and support for senior volunteers will increase.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The National Youth Council (NYC) will reach out to more youths through the Youth Corps Singapore and its partners and will rally youths to contribute to society.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The Public Service will take the lead by adopting more charities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We are also increasing support and recognition for senior volunteers, 	Page: 24 through the Silver Volunteer Fund and President's Volunteerism and Philanthropy Award.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will create more opportunities for Singaporeans of all walks of life to live, learn and play together.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will focus on building stronger community bonds amongst youths, by expanding NYC's Outward Bound Singapore adventure learning programmes and *SCAPE's music, media, dance and personal development programmes for youths.

sections.label: Sports participation for persons with disabilities
sections.summary: As a legacy of the 8th ASEAN Para Games, greater sports participation among persons with disabilities will be promoted so everyone can play.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As a legacy of the 8th ASEAN Para Games, we will promote greater sports participation among persons with disabilities, so that everyone can play a sport regardless of ability.
